title: New Moon in Aries
tldr: A seed point for courage, direct action, self-trust, and clean beginnings.
theme: Aries is a cardinal fire sign ruled traditionally by Mars. This New Moon begins work around courage, direct action, self-trust, and clean beginnings.
shadow: bulldozing without checking direction, reacting before listening, or confusing urgency with truth
integration: commanding your life without making every room a battlefield

twoWeekArc.teaching: The right people support your growth when you stop minimizing the beginning to protect everyone else.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Aries; watch what the Libra Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Mars kamea, red or orange candle, bloodstone or garnet, basil, water, incense, and a simple symbol of courage.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Aries. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through courage, direct action, self-trust, and clean beginnings, without repeating the shadow of bulldozing without checking direction, reacting before listening, or confusing urgency with truth?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Aries intention take form?
